core_question: How do I make canvas sneakers water-resistant? (secondary: How do I clean grime off a leather belt and keep it from cracking?)
answer_summary: Clean the sneakers, let them dry, then apply an even coat of a fabric water-repellent spray in a ventilated area, letting it cure before wearing.; after the topic shift: Wipe the belt down with a saddle soap-dampened cloth to lift dirt and oils, let it dry, then work in a leather conditioner such as mink oil to keep the leather supple and prevent cracking.
